paras.text: 1. A person's body is covered with 1.6 m² of wool clothing. The thickness of the wool is 2.0 × 10³ m (printed; 2.0 × 10⁻³ m is meant). The temperature at the outside surface of the wool is 11 °C, and the skin temperature is 36 °C. How much heat per second does the person lose due to conduction? Thermal conductivity of wool is k = 0.04 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹.
paras.urdu: 1. کسی شخص کا جسم 1.6 m² اونی کپڑوں سے ڈھکا ہے۔ اون کی موٹائی 2.0 × 10³ m (کتاب میں؛ مراد 2.0 × 10⁻³ m) ہے۔ اون کی بیرونی سطح کا درجۂ حرارت 11 °C اور جلد کا 36 °C ہے۔ ایصال سے وہ فی سیکنڈ کتنی حرارت کھوتا ہے؟ اون کی ایصالیت k = 0.04 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹۔
paras.pashto: 1. د یوه کس بدن په 1.6 m² وړینو جامو پوښل شوی. د وړۍ ضخامت 2.0 × 10³ m (په کتاب کې؛ مطلب 2.0 × 10⁻³ m) دی. د وړۍ بهرنۍ سطحه 11 °C او پوستکی 36 °C دی. د هدایت له لارې په هره ثانیه کې څومره تودوخه له لاسه ورکوي؟ k = 0.04 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹.

paras.text: 2. The external wall of a brick house has an area of 16 m² and thickness 0.3 m. The temperatures inside and outside the house are respectively 20 °C and 0 °C. Calculate the rate of heat loss through the wall. Thermal conductivity of brick is k = 0.84 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹.
paras.urdu: 2. اینٹ کے گھر کی بیرونی دیوار کا رقبہ 16 m² اور موٹائی 0.3 m ہے۔ اندر اور باہر کا درجۂ حرارت بالترتیب 20 °C اور 0 °C ہے۔ دیوار سے حرارت کے ضیاع کی شرح معلوم کریں۔ k = 0.84 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹۔
paras.pashto: 2. د خښتو د کور بهرنی دېوال 16 m² مساحت او 0.3 m ضخامت لري. دننه او بهر تودوخه په ترتیب 20 °C او 0 °C ده. له دېوال د تودوخې د ضایع کچه معلومه کړئ. k = 0.84 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹.

paras.text: 3. Window glass has thermal conductivity of 0.8 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹. Calculate the rate at which heat is conducted through a window of area 2.0 m² and thickness 4.0 mm. The temperature inside an air-conditioned room is 20 °C. The outdoor temperature is 35 °C.
paras.urdu: 3. کھڑکی کے شیشے کی ایصالیت 0.8 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹ ہے۔ 2.0 m² رقبے اور 4.0 mm موٹائی کی کھڑکی سے حرارت کے ایصال کی شرح معلوم کریں۔ ایئر کنڈیشنڈ کمرے کا درجۂ حرارت 20 °C اور باہر کا 35 °C ہے۔

lq.q: Explain conduction of heat and its mechanism. Describe any three of its practical applications.
lq.urdu: حرارت کے ایصال اور اس کے طریقۂ کار کی وضاحت کریں اور اس کے کوئی تین عملی استعمالات بیان کریں۔
lq.pashto: د تودوخې هدایت او میکانیزم یې تشریح کړئ او درې عملي کارونې یې بیان کړئ.
lq.ans: Conduction: flow of heat through matter from hot to cold parts without bulk movement. Hotter atoms vibrate more and pass energy to neighbours by collisions; in metals free electrons gain energy and diffuse to colder parts. Applications: metal cooking pots, wire gauze over a flame, pot holders/table mats of poor conductors, woolen clothes, igloos, ice box with cork, soldering (p.234-238).
lq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

lq.q: Explain thermal conductivity of a substance and its mathematical description.
lq.urdu: کسی مادے کی حرارتی ایصالیت اور اس کی ریاضیاتی تفصیل بیان کریں۔
lq.pashto: د یوې مادې تودوخیز هدایت او ریاضي بیان یې تشریح کړئ.
lq.ans: Thermal conductivity measures a substance’s ability to conduct heat. The rate of heat flow Q/t through a slab increases with temperature difference (T_h − T_c) and area A, decreases with thickness L, and depends on the material: Q/t = k A (T_h − T_c)/L, so k = QL/(A t (T_h − T_c)); unit W m⁻¹ K⁻¹ (p.238-239).
lq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

lq.q: Explain convection of heat and its mechanism. Explain any three of its practical applications.
lq.urdu: حرارت کے کنویکشن اور اس کے طریقۂ کار کی وضاحت کریں اور تین عملی استعمالات بیان کریں۔
lq.pashto: د تودوخې حمل او میکانیزم یې تشریح کړئ او درې عملي کارونې یې بیان کړئ.
lq.ans: Convection: heat transfer by bulk motion of a fluid. Heated fluid expands, becomes less dense and rises; cooler dense fluid replaces it, setting up convection currents. Applications: heating water in a kettle, sea and land breezes, thermals for birds and gliders, refrigerator air circulation, ventilation and chimneys (p.240-242).
lq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

lq.q: Explain radiation of heat and its mechanism. Describe any three of its practical applications.
lq.urdu: حرارت کی اشعاع اور اس کے طریقۂ کار کی وضاحت کریں اور تین عملی استعمالات بیان کریں۔
lq.pashto: د تودوخې وړانګې او میکانیزم یې تشریح کړئ او درې عملي کارونې یې بیان کړئ.
lq.ans: Radiation: heat transfer from hot to cold with or without a medium, by electromagnetic (mainly infrared) waves emitted by accelerating charges in vibrating molecules. Rate depends on colour/texture, surface temperature and area. Applications: black fins on refrigerator heat exchangers, shiny teapots, white summer clothing, thermos flask with silvered walls, solar heating (p.243-246).
lq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

lq.q: Discuss the greenhouse effect. Explain its importance and global warming concern.
lq.urdu: گرین ہاؤس اثر پر بحث کریں اور اس کی اہمیت اور عالمی حدت کی تشویش بیان کریں۔
lq.pashto: د شنې خونې اغېز وڅېړئ او اهمیت یې او د نړیوالې تودوخې اندېښنه بیان کړئ.
lq.ans: Earth absorbs sunlight (26% reflected, 19% absorbed by air and clouds, the rest by the surface) and re-radiates longer-wavelength infrared that greenhouse gases absorb and partly return, warming the surface by about 33 °C — essential for life. Extra CO₂ from factories and vehicles has raised the global average temperature by 0.85 °C (1880-2012); remedies: cut emissions and plant more vegetation (p.246-248).
lq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)
